timeCapsuleLetter:
Dearest Kumkum,

Across 49 continuous days and 37,523 messages, a whole universe was built one text at a time. It started with a clumsy apology for "trash talk" on a Sunday night in September, where you told him he wasn't as bad as you thought and that you'd have to change your opinion.

From that single conversation came the lore of "Kumkumon", the secret scheming around the Kingdom of Joy trip with Zunaira, and those unforgettable late nights where 10 PM turned into 2 AM without either of you noticing. Behind every playful tease about "bunny cheeks" and "eyelashes that hold a world" was a boy falling completely in love with the heart, patience, and warmth you bring into every day.

You asked him once never to take your trust for granted. These 37,523 messages stand as living proof of that promise kept—every laugh, every morning walk, and every hug safe in the little universe called us.

Happy Anniversary ♡
